handback.t:
W11 done. Both experiments finished; E1 is a clear negative, E2 is a tie on success with a localized recovery gain. Full detail and rerun commands are in results/g10_board_entry.md (two "VERIFY REQUEST — W11" blocks). Everything I ran re-ran byte-identical apart from timings.

I changed no src/*.rs and made no commits or downloads. The only new files are src/bin/g10_calib.rs, src/bin/g10_drift.rs, src/bin/g10_common/mod.rs and results/g10_*. Lib patch proposals are in results/g10_proposed_patch.md. The 5 unit tests in each bin pass.

**E1, self-calibrating threshold: not equivalent to the per-embedder tuned sim_min.**
- **Setup:** two independent families, 3 embedders each. F5 is the f5 corpus with hash, MiniLM and BGE. G1 is the hard sibling corpus, with corpus A for tuning and held-out seeds and corpus B as the fresh confirm corpus. Tuning on seeds 1-8, held 31-60, confirm 61-90, TOST margin ±0.01, Holm over all cells.
- **Specified rule** (running mean − k·std of top-1 cosine, one frozen kstd chosen on F5 and applied to G1 unchanged): 0 of 18 anchor-F1 cells were equivalent in held-out, and 0 of 18 in confirm. Mean paired diff was −0.14 on F5 and −0.05 on G1.
- **Vote routing success:** only 10 of 60 cells were equivalent in each split. Against the untuned library default (k5, sim .6), the rule is a tie.
- **Extra variant, labelled as such:** a chance-level floor (mean + 2·std of the cosine to random earlier queries). It recovers about 57% of the tuning gain on anchor F1 and about 44% on H2000, but is still 0 of 18 equivalent on anchor F1.
- **Why it fails:**
  - **Peaked F1:** F1 is sharply peaked in the threshold (MiniLM on F5: .907 at .50, .847 at .55).
  - **Tuned values do not map to a constant:** in top-1 sigmas the tuned values span kstd −1.6 to +2.3. In chance-level sigmas they span 1.4–2.45.
  - **Duplicates dominate:** 86–94% of top-1 hits in these worlds are exact duplicates.
- **Control caveat:** the unique-context control cannot show spurious anchors here, because the tuned incumbent also joins 97–99% of those tasks to an existing anchor. The routing cells on ctl-unique and ctl-irrel are the informative control.
- **Replay check:** the cached-neighbour replay I used matches the real `Knowledge` object, with 0 anchor mismatches in 36 runs.

**E2, recency-discounted vote stats: tie on success, with a recovery effect and a cost.**
- **Setup:** I added a context-drift world, with the text stream identical to the stationary world. Per run, the family is 108 Holm cells.
- **Success:** no Holm win on H500 or H2000 in either family. Event(0.98) gives about +0.004–0.006 H2000 on the F5 drift-mid world, and 0 on G1. H500 is pre-drift and is about −0.008 for the discounted arms.
- **Recovery:** after a full remap on F5, the first 300 post-drift tasks gain +0.017–0.027 and recovery is 120–240 tasks faster. This is Holm-significant and replicated across MiniLM and BGE, held-out and confirm. It does not appear on G1.
- **Cost:** stationary-world H2000 drops by 0.009–0.025.
- **Control:** on the irrelevant-context control, Event(0.98) and Time(200) are unchanged. Decaying the gate sums as well worsens it by about −0.035 (Holm loss in all 8 runs), so I rejected that variant.
- **Caveat:** none of the tuned discount configs beat undiscounted on the tuning objective itself. BGE was run zero-shot with the MiniLM picks.

**Patch recommendations (not applied):** do not adopt the E1 rule. The chance-floor is an optional opt-in only. Event(0.98) discounting is opt-in, default off.
